title: cellular-genesis: Apoptosis ATP Threshold UTAC Model — GenesisAeon Package 25
description: UTAC simulation of programmed cell death (apoptosis). Models intracellular ATP dynamics, mitochondrial membrane potential, Bcl-2/Bcl-xL anti-apoptotic network, ultrasensitive caspase cascade, and CREP criticality tensor (Γ ≈ 0.090) for cell populations. Part of the GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas (Packages 17–30).
